root_cause_label: Wrong Data Scope - False Premise That All Dataset Rows Are Science Domain
one_sentence_failure_summary: After discovering the default dataset load has no 'domain' column, the agent falsely concluded all 1000 entries must be science domain and counted tokens for the entire dataset rather than checking the dataset README or alternative configurations for the proper science-domain filter.
t_err_evidence: filters for domain == 'science' instead of the science-related domains and counts a nonexistent 'deepseek' field
t_commit_evidence: Step 9 creates count_tokens_updated.py that processes all 1000 entries without domain filtering; step 10 executes this script producing 8643290 tokens written to /app/answer.txt, locking in the wrong answer.
trigger_explanation: At step 9, having observed that the default dataset configuration has no 'domain' column and that keyword search in system prompts returned nothing, the agent formed an unverified assumption that all 1000 samples are science domain. The correct approach would have been to check the dataset README (visible in the download: 'README.md: 8.48kB') or try loading with alternative configurations (e.g., load_dataset(..., 'metadata')). Instead the agent treated absence of evidence as evidence of absence and locked in a wrong scope for counting.
